summary: First full-stack run of Crypto Conex (APP DE SUPORTE TÉCNICO). Backend: 27 pytest tests (REST and Socket.IO via python-socketio); 25 pass. Frontend: Playwright E2E with a fake getDisplayMedia (canvas.captureStream) injected into the public page. The full flow works: public /assistir/<code> shows the technician name, CONECTAR puts the request in the admin dashboard queue in real time, the admin assigns it to Técnico 1, Técnico 1 clicks Aceitar, and the client sees 'Assistência ativa'. Real WebRTC video reaches crm-stream-video (1280x720, state connected). Also working: chat both ways; zoom 100->125->75%; control toggle disabled for browser clients; privacy overlay 'Ajuste Técnico — Aguarde...' and disabling it from the client; transfer to Técnico 2; ending from the client; history with DD/MM/AAAA dates. Settings, Devices, RBAC, lockout, refresh rotation and reuse detection, reconnection resume and dashboard stats/clock/footer also pass. Found 2 functional bugs (link 'Sem validade' fails; the previous technician keeps receiving session events after a transfer) and 1 security weakness (IP rate limit bypass via X-Forwarded-For).

critical.endpoint: Socket.IO transfer flow (POST /api/sessions/{sid}/transfer -> realtime room session:{sid})
critical.issue: After a transfer the previous technician's socket(s) stay in room session:{sid}. They keep receiving chat:message, session:op, privacy:* and webrtc:offer/ice from the client even though REST now returns 404 for them. Confirmed by test_old_tech_removed_from_room_after_transfer. Fix: in _assign (action transfer), call sio.leave_room(sid_x, f'session:{id}') for every sid in ONLINE_USERS[old_technician_id] (unless the user is super_admin).

days=0 ('Sem validade' in the Links UI) is rejected with 422 because LinkCreate.days has ge=1. In the UI this shows the toast 'Dados inválidos: verifique os campos.' Fix: change it to Field(None, ge=0, le=365); the create code already treats 0 as no expiry.

minor.issue: client_ip trusts the first value of X-Forwarded-For, so a client can spoof it. Confirmed: while rate-limited ('Demasiados pedidos'), the same request with the header X-Forwarded-For: 9.9.9.9 is accepted. Use the right-most / trusted-proxy hop instead. The per-email lockout still works.
db.login_attempts.delete_many({}) clears the lockouts of ALL accounts whenever any user completes a password reset. It should delete only {'email': user_email}.
Rotation is not atomic (find_one then update_one). Two parallel refreshes with the same token can both succeed. Use find_one_and_update({'token_hash':..,'revoked':False}, {'$set':{'revoked':True}}).
This limit is shared by everyone behind the same NAT or egress IP. The test suite alone tripped it ('Demasiados pedidos' on the CRM login). Consider a higher limit or keying on IP+email.

ui_bugs.issue: Choosing 'Sem validade' (value 0) and clicking 'Gerar novo link' fails with the toast 'Dados inválidos' (backend 422 above).
There is no handler for the 'session:transferred' event and no load()/redirect, so Técnico 1 stays on a stale /crm/atendimentos/<id> viewer that still shows the session as active, with no toast.

integration_issues.issue: ConnectPage calls a.start("") and has no name input, so client_name is always empty and the CRM shows '—' as client name in the history and queue.

issues: The search input, OS filter and status filter render as three stacked full-width rows. inputCls contains w-full, which overrides w-44/w-36, so the filters should be inline.
Actors are shown as raw UUIDs instead of user names/emails.
A non-existent or revoked code shows 'Este link expirou', which is misleading for revoked or invalid links (minor).
There is no footer credit 'Criado por Victor Silva (Rafael Amorim)' on the public page; it appears only in the CRM and the login page. Check whether it is required on every page.

action_items: Allow days=0 in LinkCreate (ge=0) so 'Sem validade' links work
On transfer, remove the old technician's sockets from room session:{sid} (sio.leave_room), and handle 'session:transferred' in useViewer (toast plus navigate to /crm/atendimentos)
Harden client_ip: do not trust a client-supplied first X-Forwarded-For hop
In /auth/reset only clear login_attempts for that user's email
Make the refresh token rotation atomic
Fix the Devices filter layout (selects full width)
Optional: show actor names in Auditoria; add a client name input or remove client_name handling
critical_code_review_comments: realtime._assign/_relay: room membership is never revoked on transfer, and access is checked only on emit, not on receive
server.list_users / list_devices: an N+1 count_documents per row (fine for now, but slow at scale)
consent:update lets browser-platform devices set consent.control=true; harmless because browsers cannot execute commands, but the server could reject control for platform 'browser'

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all requested flows pass except link 'Sem validade' and stale viewer after transfer)

test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md TEST accounts (test_admin, test_tecnico1, test_tecnico2 / TestConex#2026). Owner account not touched.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ devices, links (revoked) and sessions (ended). Settings were restored to the originals (retention 180, github_repo ''). Temporary technicians test_tmp_*/test_ui_* were created and deleted. Several 'Linux · Chrome' browser devices from the UI runs remain offline with ended sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest -q (pytest.ini forces -n 2). Realtime tests use socketio polling and take about 2 min. The IP login rate limit is 20 per 5 min: in Playwright, set the extra header X-Forwarded-For with a unique IP per context to avoid 'Demasiados pedidos' (this only works while the XFF bug exists). Fake screen capture: add_init_script overriding navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia with canvas.captureStream(); WebRTC then connects for real. In the tech picker, select technicians by has_text 'TEST Técnico Um' / 'TEST Técnico Dois'.
rca of the issue: Transfer leak: support_request/session_join/support_accepted call enter_room(session:{sid}), but _assign (transfer) never calls leave_room for the previous technician, and Socket.IO room broadcasts do not re-check _access for receivers. Links 0 days: pydantic LinkCreate.days = Field(None, ge=1, le=365), while the UI offers [0,'Sem validade'].
